title: Associativity of K-flat total tensor complexes across a ring tower
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, let A and B be commutative R-algebras, and let E and K be complexes of A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Choose K-flat resolutions P_E \to E and P_K \to K over A and Q \to B over R [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. The canonical rebracketing map of total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] from Tot((P_E tensor_A P_K) tensor_R Q) to Tot(P_E tensor_A (P_K tensor_R Q)) is a natural chain isomorphism. After passage to D(A) it commutes with the endomorphisms of both sides induced by any endomorphism of B in D(R) (transported along Q \to B; in particular with the action of each b in B by multiplication on B), and after passage to the derived category D(A) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] it is independent of the chosen resolutions and natural in E, K and morphisms.
